result.title: Event-Based Person Detection for Maritime UAV Search
result.comment: Accepted at the 5th Workshop on Maritime Computer Vision (MaCVi), WACV 2027
result.summary: Maritime search and rescue requires locating people in the water quickly, motivating the use of UAVs to survey the search area. During flight, camera motion and the longer exposures used in low light can blur small targets and hinder person detection. Event cameras record brightness changes as they occur, reducing the motion blur associated with longer exposure times. We investigate their use for maritime person detection by generating synthetic events using the v2e event simulator from public MOBDrone rescue videos and retaining the existing annotations. We compare the recurrent vision transformer model RVT-T with YOLOv8n and RT-DETR-R18 trained on exposure-matched images. On 843 test samples from held-out recordings, RVT-T achieves 15.63% person AP50:95, compared with 6.89% for YOLOv8n and 9.44% for RT-DETR-R18 under 100 ms synthetic exposure. Increasing exposure times from 50 to 200 ms progressively reduces frame-based detection accuracy, widening the gap to the event model. To evaluate the feasibility of on-board processing, we deploy our detector on a Jetson Orin Nano platform. The RVT-T model retains its accuracy and requires approximately 136 ms and 2.02 J per sample, allowing real-time processing on the UAV.

AI.brief_summary: 该文用 v2e 将海上搜救视频转为合成事件流，比较循环视觉 Transformer RVT-T 与 YOLOv8n、RT-DETR-R18 在长曝光模糊下的人员检测表现，并在 Jetson Orin Nano 上测得延迟与能耗。
AI.relevance_reason: RVT-T 以循环隐状态随事件流累积视觉证据，其在曝光退化下优于单帧模型的对比及逐样本时延/能耗核算，可能为 LVR 的状态更新与计算成本权衡提供可核查的方法线索。
